paragraphs.source_en: After a grave illness, Tokugawa Ieyasu realized that the gods and buddhas favored neither Toyotomi Hideyoshi nor Ieyasu, but stood as impartial judges for the good of the realm. units.source_en: He deliberately added Oda Urakusai and Sorori Shinzaemon, recommended by the people of Sakai, to his retinue, proclaiming everywhere he went that the new kampaku was both approachable and warmly human.
units.source_zh: 他故意把织田有乐斋和堺港人推荐的曾吕利新左卫门也编入部队，每到一处便大肆宣扬：这个新关白既平易近人，又饶有人情味。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉这次出征好像游山玩水一样。他故意把织田有乐斋和堺港人推荐的曾吕利新左卫门也编入部队，每到一处便大肆宣扬：这个新关白既平易近人，又饶有人情味。

paragraphs.source_en: However stubborn Narimasa might be, with Niwa Nagahide already dead by his own hand and Ieyasu’s main forces assembled elsewhere, no one would come to his aid. Hideyoshi intended simply to surround Narimasa and thoroughly toy with this famously obstinate man. There was no question of tactics or strategy; he merely wished to show the world how the methods and schemes of an old-style warrior differed from those of the newly appointed kampaku.

units.source_en: However stubborn Narimasa might be, with Niwa Nagahide already dead by his own hand and Ieyasu’s main forces assembled elsewhere, no one would come to his aid.
units.source_zh: 成政再怎么顽固，但由于丹羽长秀业已自杀，家康主力又集结于别处，因此，无人会助他一臂之力。

units.source_en: Hideyoshi intended simply to surround Narimasa and thoroughly toy with this famously obstinate man.
units.source_zh: 秀吉打算干脆把成政包围起来，好好作弄作弄这个有名的顽固之人。

units.source_en: There was no question of tactics or strategy; he merely wished to show the world how the methods and schemes of an old-style warrior differed from those of the newly appointed kampaku.

ja.t: せようというのである。

units.source_zh: 这绝无什么战术战略可言，单是要让人看看，旧时武将和新任关白的手腕和策略有何不同。

paragraphs.source_zh: 成政再怎么顽固，但由于丹羽长秀业已自杀，家康主力又集结于别处，因此，无人会助他一臂之力。秀吉打算干脆把成政包围起来，好好作弄作弄这个有名的顽固之人。这绝无什么战术战略可言，单是要让人看看，旧时武将和新任关白的手腕和策略有何不同。

paragraphs.source_en: In that sense, Narimasa could be called more fortunate than ever before—and more unfortunate than ever before. He was fortunate because his life was never in danger from the outset; unfortunate because, though his life was spared, he became a mere foil employed to demonstrate Hideyoshi’s greatness.

units.source_en: In that sense, Narimasa could be called more fortunate than ever before—and more unfortunate than ever before.
units.source_zh: 从这个意义来讲，可以说成政是从未有过地幸运，也是从未有过地不幸。

units.source_en: He was fortunate because his life was never in danger from the outset; unfortunate because, though his life was spared, he became a mere foil employed to demonstrate Hideyoshi’s greatness.
units.source_zh: 幸运的是，一开始他便性命无虞，不幸的是，虽保存了性命，却成了用来证明秀吉之伟大的陪衬。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从这个意义来讲，可以说成政是从未有过地幸运，也是从未有过地不幸。幸运的是，一开始他便性命无虞，不幸的是，虽保存了性命，却成了用来证明秀吉之伟大的陪衬。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus neither side would withdraw: at Ueda Castle on one front and in Hokuriku on the other, war flared fiercely.

units.source_en: Thus neither side would withdraw: at Ueda Castle on one front and in Hokuriku on the other, war flared fiercely.
units.source_zh: 因此，双方都不会撤退，一方在上田城，另一方在北陆，战事大起。

paragraphs.source_zh: 因此，双方都不会撤退，一方在上田城，另一方在北陆，战事大起。

paragraphs.source_en: This did not, of course, mean that Ieyasu ceased attacking the Sanada forces. But having observed the arrival of the Uesugi army and Hideyoshi’s movements, he intended to watch the situation here and await his opportunity, while also testing the abilities of his troops throughout Kai and Shinano. Meanwhile, the reconstruction of Sunpu Castle proceeded in stages.

units.source_en: This did not, of course, mean that Ieyasu ceased attacking the Sanada forces. But having observed the arrival of the Uesugi army and Hideyoshi’s movements, he intended to watch the situation here and await his opportunity, while also testing the abilities of his troops throughout Kai and Shinano.
units.source_zh: 当然，这并不表示家康不再向真田的部队发动攻势了，只是他看到了上杉军队的到来和秀吉的动向，想在这里观察形势，伺机而动，也借以观察在甲信诸地的部队的能耐。

units.source_en: Meanwhile, the reconstruction of Sunpu Castle proceeded in stages.
units.source_zh: 在此期间，骏府城陆续开始重建。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当然，这并不表示家康不再向真田的部队发动攻势了，只是他看到了上杉军队的到来和秀吉的动向，想在这里观察形势，伺机而动，也借以观察在甲信诸地的部队的能耐。在此期间，骏府城陆续开始重建。

paragraphs.source_en: On the twenty-sixth of the ninth month, acting on news of Hideyoshi, Ieyasu ordered the forces near Ueda to consider withdrawing.

units.source_en: On the twenty-sixth of the ninth month, acting on news of Hideyoshi, Ieyasu ordered the forces near Ueda to consider withdrawing.
units.source_zh: 九月二十六，家康根据关于秀吉的消息，下令上田附近的军队考虑撤退。

paragraphs.source_zh: 九月二十六，家康根据关于秀吉的消息，下令上田附近的军队考虑撤退。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu himself had returned to Hamamatsu Castle five days earlier, assembled the commanders who remained there, and completed his dispositions; on the twenty-sixth he ordered the Ueda army home, then leisurely inspected Nishio and Kira Castle in Mikawa.

units.source_en: Ieyasu himself had returned to Hamamatsu Castle five days earlier, assembled the commanders who remained there, and completed his dispositions;
units.source_zh: 家康自己在五日前已回到了滨松城，集合留在那里的诸将，部署完毕；

units.source_en: on the twenty-sixth he ordered the Ueda army home, then leisurely inspected Nishio and Kira Castle in Mikawa.
units.source_zh: 二十六日则命上田军队撤回，然后悠然巡视三河的西尾及吉良城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康自己在五日前已回到了滨松城，集合留在那里的诸将，部署完毕；二十六日则命上田军队撤回，然后悠然巡视三河的西尾及吉良城。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi, having conquered the northern provinces as planned, renewed his alliance with Uesugi Kagekatsu, returned to Osaka, and began preparing his campaign against Shikoku.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi, having conquered the northern provinces as planned, renewed his alliance with Uesugi Kagekatsu, returned to Osaka, and began preparing his campaign against Shikoku.
units.source_zh: 按计划攻下北国的秀吉则重新与上杉景胜结为盟友，回到大坂，开始部署攻打四国之策。

paragraphs.source_zh: 按计划攻下北国的秀吉则重新与上杉景胜结为盟友，回到大坂，开始部署攻打四国之策。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu inspected the coastal defenses because he feared a surprise attack on Mikawa by Hideyoshi’s powerful navy. Yet the men’s morale was high and the defenses fully prepared; that hardly needed saying.

units.source_en: Ieyasu inspected the coastal defenses because he feared a surprise attack on Mikawa by Hideyoshi’s powerful navy.
units.source_zh: 家康唯恐秀吉强大的水军奇袭三河，才巡视海防工事。

units.source_en: Yet the men’s morale was high and the defenses fully prepared; that hardly needed saying.
units.source_zh: 但那里士气旺盛，军备齐全，自不待赘言。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康唯恐秀吉强大的水军奇袭三河，才巡视海防工事。但那里士气旺盛，军备齐全，自不待赘言。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi had accomplished his design, while Ieyasu continued to vie with him through feints and realities.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi had accomplished his design, while Ieyasu continued to vie with him through feints and realities.
units.source_zh: 秀吉完成了计划，家康也在虚虚实实地与之竞争。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉完成了计划，家康也在虚虚实实地与之竞争。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu’s withdrawal without destroying Sanada Masayuki and his son greatly displeased Hōjō Ujimasa of Odawara. This had been expected, yet it was the one matter that continued to trouble Ieyasu. If Ujimasa learned that Ieyasu’s attack on the Sanadas had really been only a pretext for building Sunpu Castle, he might fly into a rage and even send troops into Suruga. The Hōjō must now be conciliated.

units.source_en: Ieyasu’s withdrawal without destroying Sanada Masayuki and his son greatly displeased Hōjō Ujimasa of Odawara. This had been expected, yet it was the one matter that continued to trouble Ieyasu.
units.source_zh: 只是，家康没有消灭真田昌幸父子而撤兵，令小田原北条氏政大为不满，这原本在预料之中，也是唯一让他耿耿于怀之事。

units.source_en: If Ujimasa learned that Ieyasu’s attack on the Sanadas had really been only a pretext for building Sunpu Castle, he might fly into a rage and even send troops into Suruga.
units.source_zh: 若氏政知道家康此次攻打真田，其实只是想借机筑造骏府城，或许会大怒，甚至会出兵骏河。

units.source_en: The Hōjō must now be conciliated.
units.source_zh: 现在必须对北条氏采取怀柔之策。

paragraphs.source_zh: 只是，家康没有消灭真田昌幸父子而撤兵，令小田原北条氏政大为不满，这原本在预料之中，也是唯一让他耿耿于怀之事。若氏政知道家康此次攻打真田，其实只是想借机筑造骏府城，或许会大怒，甚至会出兵骏河。现在必须对北条氏采取怀柔之策。

paragraphs.source_en: Just then, however, Hideyoshi presented him with another unexpected dilemma.

units.source_en: Just then, however, Hideyoshi presented him with another unexpected dilemma.
units.source_zh: 此时，秀吉却又给他出了个意想不到的难题。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，秀吉却又给他出了个意想不到的难题。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi’s demand was this: from that day until Shikoku, Kyushu, and every other part of the realm had been completely pacified, all daimyō were to send hostages to Osaka as a pledge to Hideyoshi that they would assist him in restoring peace. Since all had now submitted, Ieyasu too must, like every daimyō in the realm, send a hostage without delay.

units.source_en: Hideyoshi’s demand was this: from that day until Shikoku, Kyushu, and every other part of the realm had been completely pacified, all daimyō were to send hostages to Osaka as a pledge to Hideyoshi that they would assist him in restoring peace.

ja.t: せよ、というものだった。

units.source_zh: 秀吉出的难题是：从即日起，直到四国、九州等天下各地完全平定为止，所有大名都要派人质去大坂，以向秀吉保证，协助他重建太平。

units.source_en: Since all had now submitted, Ieyasu too must, like every daimyō in the realm, send a hostage without delay.
units.source_zh: 既然大家都已臣服，家康也要和天下大名一样，马上派人质。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉出的难题是：从即日起，直到四国、九州等天下各地完全平定为止，所有大名都要派人质去大坂，以向秀吉保证，协助他重建太平。既然大家都已臣服，家康也要和天下大名一样，马上派人质。

paragraphs.source_en: Why had Hideyoshi’s attitude suddenly grown so forceful?

units.source_en: Why had Hideyoshi’s attitude suddenly grown so forceful?
units.source_zh: 为何秀吉的态度会突然变得如此强硬呢？

paragraphs.source_zh: 为何秀吉的态度会突然变得如此强硬呢？

paragraphs.source_en: One reason was that his new strategy against Sassa Narimasa had succeeded. Another was that, upon becoming kampaku, Hideyoshi had already secured the private sanction of the grand minister of state: he was not only Japan’s de facto ruler but also a great hero who stood below one man and above all others. Thus Hideyoshi no longer needed force to deal with the daimyō. He could command the lords through the majesty of the imperial house and openly issue his decrees—and in that guise he now meant to swallow Ieyasu whole.

units.source_en: One reason was that his new strategy against Sassa Narimasa had succeeded. Another was that, upon becoming kampaku, Hideyoshi had already secured the private sanction of the grand minister of state: he was not only Japan’s de facto ruler but also a great hero who stood below one man and above all others.
units.source_zh: 除了他攻打佐佐成政时的新策略已经奏效，还有一个原因，那便是秀吉当上关白时，已经获得太政大臣私下许可：他不仅是日本的实权者，也是一人之下、万人之上的大英雄。

units.source_en: Thus Hideyoshi no longer needed force to deal with the daimyō. He could command the lords through the majesty of the imperial house and openly issue his decrees—and in that guise he now meant to swallow Ieyasu whole.

ja.t: となれる。そしてまさにその

units.source_zh: 如此一来，秀吉已不必再靠武力去对付诸大名了，他可借皇室威严以令诸侯，做一个堂堂的发号施令者——他正要以这种姿态吞噬家康。

paragraphs.source_zh: 除了他攻打佐佐成政时的新策略已经奏效，还有一个原因，那便是秀吉当上关白时，已经获得太政大臣私下许可：他不仅是日本的实权者，也是一人之下、万人之上的大英雄。如此一来，秀吉已不必再靠武力去对付诸大名了，他可借皇室威严以令诸侯，做一个堂堂的发号施令者——他正要以这种姿态吞噬家康。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu had already withdrawn his troops from Ueda Castle, which stood under Hideyoshi’s protection. From this, Hideyoshi inferred that Ieyasu had fully grasped his intentions and had therefore been forced to withdraw, while also knowing his own strength and proceeding cautiously.

units.source_en: Ieyasu had already withdrawn his troops from Ueda Castle, which stood under Hideyoshi’s protection.
units.source_zh: 家康已经从秀吉庇护下的上田城退兵。

units.source_en: From this, Hideyoshi inferred that Ieyasu had fully grasped his intentions and had therefore been forced to withdraw, while also knowing his own strength and proceeding cautiously.

ja.t: り、やむなくそうしたのだと

units.source_zh: 此事使秀吉推测，家康已充分认识到他的用意，因而不得已为此，同时又甚知己力，小心行事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康已经从秀吉庇护下的上田城退兵。此事使秀吉推测，家康已充分认识到他的用意，因而不得已为此，同时又甚知己力，小心行事。

paragraphs.source_en: Sassa Narimasa had yielded to Hideyoshi with ease and even accompanied him to Kyoto, further displaying Hideyoshi’s power. Uesugi Kagekatsu likewise announced throughout the realm that he would give the new kampaku his fullest support. Naturally, the daimyō would meekly hand over their hostages. The tide turned ever more strongly in Hideyoshi’s favor; Ieyasu could therefore refuse no longer.

units.source_en: Sassa Narimasa had yielded to Hideyoshi with ease and even accompanied him to Kyoto, further displaying Hideyoshi’s power.
units.source_zh: 佐佐成政轻而易举便被秀吉收服，还陪着他来到了京城，更显示出秀吉的威力。

units.source_en: Uesugi Kagekatsu likewise announced throughout the realm that he would give the new kampaku his fullest support.
units.source_zh: 而上杉景胜也通告天下，要鼎力协助新关白。

units.source_en: Naturally, the daimyō would meekly hand over their hostages.
units.source_zh: 诸大名当然会唯唯诺诺交出人质。

units.source_en: The tide turned ever more strongly in Hideyoshi’s favor; Ieyasu could therefore refuse no longer.

ja.t: むことはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 形势对秀吉越来越有利，因此，家康不能再拒绝。

paragraphs.source_zh: 佐佐成政轻而易举便被秀吉收服，还陪着他来到了京城，更显示出秀吉的威力。而上杉景胜也通告天下，要鼎力协助新关白。诸大名当然会唯唯诺诺交出人质。形势对秀吉越来越有利，因此，家康不能再拒绝。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet Hideyoshi demanded not only one of Ieyasu’s children, but also that the families of his chief retainers be sent to Osaka. He did not consider his demand difficult at all, insisting only that they recognize it as a natural and proper response to the course of the times. But to the indignant Tokugawa clan, it was a dilemma through and through.

units.source_en: Yet Hideyoshi demanded not only one of Ieyasu’s children, but also that the families of his chief retainers be sent to Osaka.
units.source_zh: 而秀吉居然要求除了家康的孩子以外，还要送重臣的家人去大坂。

units.source_en: He did not consider his demand difficult at all, insisting only that they recognize it as a natural and proper response to the course of the times.
units.source_zh: 他并不认为自己出了个难题，一味地强调：要认清这乃是顺应时势、理所当然之事。

units.source_en: But to the indignant Tokugawa clan, it was a dilemma through and through.

ja.t: にとっては、まぎれもなく

units.source_zh: 可是，对群情激愤的德川氏而言，这可是彻头彻尾的难题。

paragraphs.source_zh: 而秀吉居然要求除了家康的孩子以外，还要送重臣的家人去大坂。他并不认为自己出了个难题，一味地强调：要认清这乃是顺应时势、理所当然之事。可是，对群情激愤的德川氏而言，这可是彻头彻尾的难题。

paragraphs.source_en: From the fifteenth day of the tenth month, the chief retainers began coming and going incessantly. On the twenty-eighth of that month, after Hideyoshi pressed him again, Ieyasu hastily assembled all his senior retainers at Hamamatsu Castle. The air was heavy with the threat of an explosion.

units.source_en: From the fifteenth day of the tenth month, the chief retainers began coming and going incessantly.
units.source_zh: 重臣们于十月十五开始频频往来。

units.source_en: On the twenty-eighth of that month, after Hideyoshi pressed him again, Ieyasu hastily assembled all his senior retainers at Hamamatsu Castle.
units.source_zh: 同月二十八，因为秀吉再次催促，家康遂把全体重臣临时集结于滨松城。

units.source_en: The air was heavy with the threat of an explosion.
units.source_zh: 这时空气中火药味甚重。

paragraphs.source_zh: 重臣们于十月十五开始频频往来。同月二十八，因为秀吉再次催促，家康遂把全体重臣临时集结于滨松城。这时空气中火药味甚重。
